pages.title: Make the Connection
pages.text: Plan transfers using real services; displays and platforms make that route easier to use.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Set minimum transfer time and allowed train categories. Permitted aliases group platforms; exclusions remove unwanted stations/trains. Enable desired native route updates.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use the Navigator to search between stations on an existing Create rail network. View possible routes with departures and delays.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Set minimum transfer time and allowed train categories; use shared station aliases and train/station exclusions where permitted. Group platforms into a station and keep unwanted routes out of passenger suggestions.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Enable the native route overlay options, notifications or narrator while following a route. Receive stop and transfer updates; station clocks can report current time and be expanded to four sides.
